The tool output truncated the middle of the pytest run, so this list may be incomplete. You asked for a single run, so I haven't re-run it.

Test files with failures that are visible in the output:

- `tests/test_arguments.py` (first test fails)
- `tests/test_basic.py` (first test fails)
- `tests/test_commands.py` (first test fails)
- `tests/test_context.py` (first test fails)
- `tests/test_options.py` (first test fails)
- `tests/test_parser.py` (first 5 tests fail)
- `tests/test_utils/test_echo_via_pager.py` (the pager output file was empty instead of `'just text\n'`, seen in the failure traceback)

The progress lines after `tests/test_utils/test__expand_args.py` at 78%, up to the failure details, were cut off. Other files in that range, which would include the rest of `tests/test_utils/`, could also contain failures that I couldn't see. The final pytest summary was cut off too, so I don't have the totals.

The six test files with local modifications in git status are the same six that fail on their first test. That suggests those uncommitted changes are the cause. I haven't checked that.

If you want a complete list, I can re-run with the output written to a file, for example `python -m pytest -rf > /tmp/out.txt`.
